item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions contain four matching stanza blocks. Updated the titles and right-to-left direction, and removed `noUrdu`.

“Mir Hasan Mir” may be a reciter credit. I retained it in the opening line of both editions because it appeared in the supplied verse, and omitted it from the poem titles.
